title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-nov-2025-draft
content:
Goal:
- Align Product, Eng (serving-runtime + infra), and Applied ML on high-level roadmap priorities for Q1–Q2 2026 and identify blocking dependencies.

Context / background:
- Product has prioritized three near-term bets: 1) streaming + function/tool-calling polish for hosted API, 2) Dedicated autoscaling and burst capacity improvements, 3) Private deployment onboarding for two regulated customers in EMEA.
- Applied ML is validating two open models (fast-llama-v2-small and redwood-lite-1) for quality/cost tradeoffs and will have quantization profiles ready by mid-December.
- Serving/runtime team has a tentative milestone to ship kernel selection improvements and KV-cache UX by end of January to improve tail latency.

Participants (invited):
- Maya Patel (Product) — owner
- Evan Liu (Eng - Serving Runtime)
- Priya Rao (Applied ML)
- Liam O'Connor (Infra / Dedicated)
- Avi Shankar (Product - Console & Rollouts)
- Optional: SRE rep (TBD)

Agenda (30–45 min):
1) Quick status updates (5–7 min) — each team 
   - 1–2 bullets on progress and immediate blockers
2) Prioritization review (10–15 min)\   - Which items must land to support customer commitments (Private onboarding + Dedicated SLAs)\   - Knock-on work to support Hosted API improvements (streaming, func-calls)\3) Cross-team dependencies and timeline (10 min)\   - Infra capacity / autoscaling needs for Dedicated + Hosted traffic patterns\   - Model quantization and eval gating from Applied ML\4) Risks / mitigation (5 min)\5) Action items & owners (5 min)

Key prep notes / talking points:
- Product: clarify which customer commitments are firm vs exploratory. For the two EMEA customers, what features are absolute must-haves vs nice-to-have (e.g., on-prem installer, KMS integration, extended audit log retention). I expect we need a short feature matrix. (Action: Maya to bring customer ask summary).
- Applied ML: can you confirm the expected latency/quality delta for the two candidate models once quantized? Need concrete numbers (p50/p95 latency, top-level QA metrics) to evaluate whether we can recommend them as fallback variants for cost routing. (Action: Priya to present preliminary eval table).
- Serving runtime: kernel selection landing in Jan is great — need to quantify the risk window if it slips 2–4 weeks. What temporary mitigations can infra/serving do (e.g., conservative batching configs, K-V cache warmup strategies)? (Action: Evan to list fallbacks).
- Infra/Dedicated: autoscaling changes will impact cost model and rollout timeline. We need a plan for customer-facing billing/commit messaging if capacity is constrained. Also confirm whether burst capacity infra is gated by capacity pool provisioning or software. (Action: Liam to summarize infra constraints + timeline).

Open questions to surface in sync:
- Which roadmap item gets highest priority if we must choose between Dedicated autoscaling and Hosted streaming polish? How does that choice affect sales commitments?
- Is there a minimum quantization profile we can ship as experimental that Applied ML signs off on (i.e., lower perf guarantee, opt-in)?
- What are the non-negotiable security/compliance items for the EMEA customer pilot? (KMS, audit, network isolation)

Draft decisions we may want to make in meeting:
- Commit to Dedicated autoscaling MVP by end of Q1 2026 with an initial SLA for throughput (define SLA in follow-up).
- Ship hosted streaming improvements in staged rollout with feature-flagged fallback to older streaming path for 2 weeks post-launch.
- Approve trial quantized model rollout to internal traffic only for first 30 days.

Action items (draft):
- Maya: pull together 1-page customer ask matrix for EMEA pilots (due: 2025-11-10).
- Priya: final eval table for candidate models with latency/p95, cost delta, and QA pass rates (due: 2025-11-12).
- Evan: list fallback strategies if kernel selection misses Jan target; include quick config changes we can apply (due: 2025-11-11).
- Liam: infra capacity note: pool provisioning timeline and burst capacity gating, plus impact on cost model (due: 2025-11-13).
- Avi: draft rollout/feature flag plan for hosted streaming improvements including canary thresholds (due: 2025-11-14).
- All: add missing dependencies to JIRA-ROADMAP-142 and tag owners (due: 2025-11-07).

Notes to self / meeting logistics:
- Keep meeting tight: aim 30 min. If dependencies run long, schedule follow-up deeper dive with infra + SRE.
- Bring concrete numbers (latency, cost, customer deadlines) — avoid fuzzy timelines.
- After sync: update Confluence row (CONFLUENCE-ROADMAP-2025) and tag roadmap ticket JIRA-ROADMAP-142 with any new sub-tasks.

Rough timeline/next checkpoint:
- Sync on 2025-11-06 (tentative) to confirm decisions and publish short roadmap update to exec.

Misc notes / fragments:
- Potential risk: quantizing larger models may introduce hallucination regression; add small eval suite for prompt sets likely to be customer-critical. (Priya + Product to pair on eval design)
- If Dedicated autoscaling needs new billing signals, loop in finance early (TBD).

Quick links I might reference in meeting:
- CONFLUENCE-ROADMAP-2025 (high-level roadmap)
- JIRA-ROADMAP-142 (main tracker)
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-onboarding/pull/34 (quant profiles)

-- end of prep notes --

(Informal scratchpad style — will tidy up summary after sync and assign final owners in Jira)
